reason: Quote 'till the Beloved will descend ... will descend, I say into the world in the last days Yahuah (Lord), who will be called Messiah (Christ)' is verbatim in 9:12; Matt 1:23 link intact.
'And behold the heavens were opened, and an angel of Elohim (God) said to me, Levi, enter.' is verbatim at 18:6; TXII 18:6 is Levi's vision (Levi 17-35); Matt 3:16 link holds.

Long quote of 3:13 ('Beliar was in great wrath against Isaiah ... buried in the sepulchre') is verbatim; it is the Beliar-wrath/Beloved-made-known verse the old note described, not 1:3 (judgments of Gehenna). Matt 4:10 quote verbatim.
'a star arise to you from Jacob in peace ... no sin shall be found in him' is verbatim at 59:1 (Judah 36-61); 58:5 is the captivity verse. Son of David link in Matt 20:30 truthful.
'Until the El Elyon (Most High) shall visit the earth, coming Himself ... all the Gentiles' sits at 109:3 (Asher 103-110), the next verse after the scattering at 109:2; Matt 24:30 quote verbatim.

'In thee shall be fulfilled the prophecy of heaven ... blameless one shall be delivered up ... blood of the covenant' is verbatim at 133:8 (Benjamin 131-142), which the old note quoted; 133:6 is Joseph's intercession. Non-adjacent but justified; Matt 26:28 verbatim.

'And thereupon the angel opened to me the gates of heaven, and I saw the holy temple, and upon a throne of glory the El Elyon (Most High)' is verbatim at 21:1 (Levi 17-35), not 20:5 (counsel and understanding); Matt 27:51 quote verbatim.
'love one another in deed, and in word, and in the inclination of the soul' is in 100:1 (Gad 95-102), not 100:2; citation and John 13:34 connection correct.

'so will I shed My own blood ... so also will I offer My blood on an altar' is at 24:4; 24:5 is the 'forgiveness of sins' verse. Note's quoted pledge is loosely worded but points at 24:4; Heb 9:12 link holds.
'You will not be delivered from it until My coming' is at 45:10, not 45:11 ('until My Word comes'); 1 Pet 1:20 link holds.
'Here am I, thy servant.' is 11:3, not 11:6 ('Be of good cheer, and come'); Josh 5:14 link holds.
'Come with me and I will go with thee' is verbatim at 11:5, not 11:6; Acts 7:2 link holds.
'I shall depart mid the torture of my body' is at 1:7, which the note's 'I shall depart' relies on; 1:13 lacks the word. 2 Tim 4:6 link holds.
'suffereth him neither to eat nor to drink, nor to do any good thing' is verbatim at 10:2 (Simeon 8-16); 10:3 is the 'destroy him that he envieth' verse. James 3:16 link holds.

18:7 contains 'I entered from the first heaven, and I saw there a great sea hanging'; the 2 Enoch 3:1 quote ('bore him up on to the first heaven and placed him on the clouds ... and showed me a very great Sea, greater than the earthly sea') is verbatim with ellipsis.
New quoted words 'she privily sent my pledges, and put me to shame' are verbatim in 47:5; they fit Gen 38:26 (Judah acknowledging Tamar) truthfully, unlike the old unfound quote.
'by weight, and measure, and rule' sits at 87:3 (Naphtali 86-94), not 87:5; the note's 'likeness of the spirit' phrase is 87:2 but the quoted words and creation point are 87:3. Ps 139:14 link holds.
'after ye have become minished and made few, ye shall return' is verbatim at 89:3, not 89:5 (scattering/compassion); Isa 11:11 recovery of remnant fits.
'Such men are hares; for they are half clean, but in very deed are unclean' is at 104:9 (Asher 103-110); 'are unclean' now matches live text; Lev 11:6 link holds.

Quotes from 140:6-9 are verbatim (bracketed text omitted) including 'Then also all men shall rise, some unto glory and some unto shame' at 140:8; 140:6-9 is Benjamin range (131-142); Rev 20:12 quote verbatim.
Same 140:6-9 quote verbatim, citation correct for Benjamin; Rev 11:18 'the time of the dead, that they should be judged' is verbatim.
60:1 quote verbatim; 60:3 ('people of Yahuah ... cast into the fire for ever') visible and verbatim; 60:4 not shown but 'Judah 25:1,3-4' maps consistently to 60:1,3-4 (Judah 36-61).
